nodes.label: Candlekeep
nodes.desc: You stand within the towering halls of Candlekeep, a fortress of lost tomes and whispered secrets.

plot.chapter_intro: The story begins in Candlekeep, where knowledge runs deeper than gold...
plot.reveal: A scroll lies partially unrolled near your desk. It bears the mark of a forgotten god.

npcs.name: Gorion
npcs.dialogue: You must leave at once, my child...

events.text: The bells of Candlekeep toll as Gorion prepares your escape.

plot.reveal: Gorion has kept secrets from you — your past is not what it seems.

nodes.label: Baldur’s Gate
nodes.desc: The grand city looms on the horizon, full of danger and destiny.

plot.reveal: The Iron Throne may have sabotaged this site.
plot.chapter_intro: Act I: Trouble in Nashkel. You stand at the gates of danger, where every shadow hides a conspiracy.

nodes.label: Lower City
nodes.desc: Cobbled streets full of markets and chaos.

npcs.name: Rasaad
npcs.dialogue: There is balance even in chaos... if one seeks it.

events.text: A crowd gathers around a political speaker in the market square.

plot.reveal: Tensions between noble houses are rising.

nodes.label: Iron Throne Hideout
nodes.desc: Log walls, command tents, and secret messages.

npcs.name: Agent Veltran
npcs.dialogue: You're too late. The cargo has already left for Baldur's Gate.

events.text: Iron Throne guards rush to intercept you!

plot.reveal: Proof of the Iron Throne's involvement is found here.
